intent: 3.0 P1.1 + P2.1: dispatcher registers transcripts+commits, reconciles CLIENT/SERVER help tables
notes: **P1.1** — `src/gator_command/scripts/gator-enterprise.py::ENTERPRISE_CLI_VERBS`: adds `"transcripts"` and `"commits"`. Before this fix, `gator enterprise transcripts pull` (the primary MVP operator path) got rejected by the base dispatcher's pre-check with the "verb not yet integrated with enterprise-cli" notice and exit 69 — even though enterprise-cli registers both verbs (see `enterprise/enterprise-cli/gator_enterprise_cli/main.py:52-53`). The MVP was unreachable from a stock `pipx install gator-command` + source-checkout enterprise-cli install. Fixed by adding both to the frozenset. Comment block above the constant updated to name the 2026-08-09 Phase 4 fix and cross-reference the sync obligation.

**P2.1** — Same file: `CLIENT_SUBCOMMANDS` and `SERVER_SUBCOMMANDS` rewritten to reflect the real verb sets, replacing five aspirational entries per list (`setup/status/sync/audit/disconnect` and `server/db/policy/org/fleet` respectively) that never mapped to enterprise-cli commands. New `CLIENT_SUBCOMMANDS` is the developer-side verb set: `activate/sync/repo/transcripts/commits`. New `SERVER_SUBCOMMANDS` is the operator/admin verb set: `auth/repos/providers/policies/reports/machines/blocks`. Every advertised verb now maps to a real enterprise-cli command; the integration-gap notice becomes a contributor-error guard rather than an operator-visible failure mode.

**Tests** — `tests/test_gator_enterprise.py`: updated three assertions to check the new expected verb sets (`test_client_subcommands_include_expected_verbs`, `test_server_subcommands_include_expected_verbs`), swapped four occurrences of the old `main(["setup"|"status"])` scaffolding for real verbs, rewrote the two parametrized `test_*_subcommand_exits_ex_unavailable` cases to cover the real verb sets, and rewrote `test_unmapped_verb_returns_ex_unavailable_not_argparse_exit` to monkeypatch `ENTERPRISE_CLI_VERBS` (removing `transcripts`) to synthesize the advertised-but-unmapped condition — the guard's regression coverage survives even though the guard becomes unreachable in normal operation. New `test_every_advertised_verb_is_mapped` locks in the P2.1 invariant: every entry in ALL_SUBCOMMANDS must appear in ENTERPRISE_CLI_VERBS.

**Charter** — `.gator/charters/scripts-enterprise.md`: post-Phase-4e nuance section rewritten to describe the 2026-08-09 reconciliation, cross-reference the new sync obligation shape, and update the `TestIntegrationGap` regression-pin count (from the pre-fix 10+1+3 shape to the post-reconciliation 1+1+3 shape).
**Test evidence**: `tests/test_gator_enterprise.py` = 30 passed. Full base-gator suite not re-run this commit; risk is bounded to the dispatcher file.
**Not touched**: `PLAN_REF` constant (still references the vaulted 2026-07-21 monorepo convergence plan; §6.4 checklist item to verify path validity is separate work).
First of the Phase 4 (Gator 3.0 stabilization) P1 cleanup commits. Per release-readiness plan §9.
